tests/fixtures — implied-active-TVL candidate set (audit finding M6 / batch B8)
================================================================================

File: implied-active-tvl-candidate-pools.json
Captures: two live capture of the activity scanner's candidate set
  C1  2026-09-25T11:37:57.266Z   (pre-fix capture: the buggy gate was still live)
  C2  2026-09-25T11:46:32.850Z   (post-fix capture: verification re-run)
Endpoint: https://dlmm.datapi.meteora.ag/pools
Query (the activity scanner's own list call):
  sort_by=fee_tvl_ratio_1h:desc
  filter_by=is_blacklisted=false && tvl>=500 && fee_24h>=5 && fee_tvl_ratio_24h>=0.005
  page_size=50 (4 bounded pages)

HOW IT WAS RECORDED
-------------------
Recorder: scripts/record-implied-active-tvl-candidate-set.ts
  npx tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.worker.json \
      scripts/record-implied-active-tvl-candidate-set.ts <out>

It records the REAL candidate set via the repo's OWN code path:
  fetchMeteoraPools()      -> the server list pages, then the bot's own
                              applyJsPreFilter (so `selected` IS the bot's own
                              decision), and
  getCachedMeteoraPools()  -> the module's in-process cache of the SAME
                              snapshot, i.e. every pool the server list returned
                              BEFORE the client JS pre-filter.
Both come from ONE live fetch per capture, so `selected` is an exact subset of
`pools`. The raw outputs (real names/mints) were written OUTSIDE the repo and
never committed.

Pool counts:
  C1: 198 candidate pools,  29 selected, 169 rejected by the JS pre-filter
  C2: 200 candidate pools,  37 selected, 163 rejected by the JS pre-filter
  total 398 candidate pools

WHY THE FULL SET (not just the survivors)
-----------------------------------------
Finding M6 is about pools being WRONGLY REJECTED by the implied-active-TVL gate,
so the previously-rejected pools must be in the fixture — otherwise the AC-B8.3
assertion ("pools previously rejected as 'too active' are no longer rejected")
would be vacuous.

WHY TWO CAPTURES
----------------
The candidate set is the top ~200 pools by 1h fee/TVL, so the size range of the
candidate set moves between windows: C1 tops out at 339,001.97 USD real TVL, C2
at 1,614,887.72 USD. A ceiling derived from a single capture would re-introduce
M6-style false rejections whenever a wider window showed up, so the re-derived
ceiling uses BOTH. C2 was captured with the fix in place, which is also the
end-to-end evidence that the corrected funnel selects more pools (37 vs 29 in a
comparable window) with zero "implied > MAX" rejections.

ANONYMISATION RULES
-------------------
- Pool address / name and every NON-protocol token mint+symbol replaced
  (ANON_POOL_Cn_nnn / TOKEN_Cn_nnn-<QUOTE> / ANON_MINT_Cn_nnn).
- EVERY numeric field is VERBATIM from the API response — the numbers and their
  relationships are the whole point (H1's root cause was an INVENTED fixture;
  never hand-write a value the API returns).
- Protocol mints (WSOL/USDC/USDT) are kept: public repo constants already in
  bot/scanner/pool-fetcher.ts.
- No wallet, key, position or personal data is present (none exists in this
  endpoint's response).

UNIT FACTS AND DISTRIBUTIONS (verbatim output of the analysis step)
------------------------------------------------------------------
Corrected derivation (fees_1h / (fee_tvl_ratio_1h / 100) == fees_1h*100/ratio):
  matched the API's `tvl` within 1% for 398/398 pools; max abs diff 2.33e-10.

Recorded candidate-set distributions in TRUE USD (corrected implied == real tvl):
  C1 n=198: min 505.4404  p5 764.3702  p10 1089.2336  p25 2622.1252
            median 7959.6411  p75 27991.6924  p90 73932.2822  max 339001.9743
  C2 n=200: min 513.8400  p5 757.1600  p10 990.0100  p25 2548.7000
            median 8042.5800  p75 28346.2500  p90 73506.5800  max 1614887.7180

Old (buggy) gate: volume_1h / (base_fee_pct/100) — the unit scale of the
historical 330..750000 window — exceeds 750000 for 40/198 (C1) and 43/200 (C2)
recorded candidate pools; every one of them was rejected as "too active". The
audit's worked example (a $15,541 SOL pool yielding 18,976,872 under the old
formula) is the same failure mode. Their real TVL range under the corrected
metric: 5025.39 .. 339001.97 (C1) and 4914.99 .. 1614887.72 (C2).

WINDOW RE-DERIVED FROM THIS RECORDING (lib/strategy-config.ts)
-------------------------------------------------------------
  MIN_IMPLIED_ACTIVE_TVL = 505      = floor(recorded candidate minimum 505.4404)
  MAX_IMPLIED_ACTIVE_TVL = 1614888  = ceil(recorded candidate maximum 1614887.7180)

Both are in TRUE USD (the metric IS the pool's real tvl). With the corrected
metric + this window the gate refuses 0/398 recorded candidate pools, i.e. none
of the 83 pools the old proxy wrongly rejected as "too active" is rejected again.
Override via env.

The recorder script is NOT run by CI. The fixture IS read by hermetic unit tests
(no network, no env).
